description: After lithtrix_search, send helpful / unhelpful / wrong signal using ref_type search_id and ref_id from the response _lithtrix.search_id (UUID). Same tool works for memory_key, blob_id, parse_id. Stored for future routing — no secrets or PII in note. Requires LITHTRIX_API_KEY.

note.description: Optional context, max 500 characters — no secrets or PII

ref_id.description: Opaque id (e.g. search UUID from _lithtrix.search_id, memory key, blob_id)

name: lithtrix_feedback
